focus: Local runtime bridge streaming, caps, CORS, and robustness
verifiedBehaviors: Upstream model bytes stream to the browser without waiting for full generation.
Response byte caps are counted during streaming.
Backpressure is respected with drain waits.
Upstream requests are aborted when caps/timeouts/client disconnects require it.
Bridge logs do not include full prompt contents.
Bridge remains a local-only allowlisted proxy and not a general open proxy.
